items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: figure this out, Monk, will ya?

ctx.x: It used to be sort of a joke that making a living in jazz was a dangerous thing.

Yes, that’s right. Yeah. So it’s going to be — I was thinking about New York just opened up this week and there was an article in the Times saying the offices, they’re going to © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

have to jump through hoops supposedly, to be able to work in the office. They’ve got to fill out a questionnaire every day saying, you know, have you been exposed to anybody with the virus in the last two weeks, you know all this stuff. Then they’re going to take your temperature. I mean I can’t imagine that they’re going to keep that going for a couple of weeks because that’s going to — and how are you going to do that in a club or a restaurant with people constantly coming and going. I don’t know. It’s — figure…
